approved.en: Russia continues intensive air and missile attacks on Kyiv, injuring civilians and damaging the Northern Bridge and the city’s power network, while a drone strike ignited an Ozon warehouse in southern Russia. Ukraine responded by striking Russian missile launchers and air-defence systems in Bryansk Oblast and by hitting the Saratov oil refinery. Iran conveyed a secret Khamenei message to Putin as Moscow pursues a gas pipeline deal, and Azerbaijan and Ukraine signed new energy-defence and trade agreements, with Zelensky urging Latin America to help rebuild Ukraine’s power grid. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

Ukraina svarte med å treffe russiske missil-utskytnings‑ og luftvernsystemer i Bryansk-oblast og ved å angripe oljeraffineriet i Saratov. Iran overbrakte en hemmelig Khamenei-melding til Putin mens Moskva forfølger en gassrørledningsavtale, og Aserbajdsjan og Ukraina signerte nye energi-forsvars‑ og handelsavtaler, med Zelensky som oppfordrer Latin-America til å hjelpe med å gjenoppbygge Ukrainas strømnett. Kamprelaterte dødsfall beløp seg til 75 767 i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Israeli forces continue coalition negotiations, with talks gaining momentum and a candidate named to form the next government, while Israeli settlers seized eight Palestinian homes in Jericho, displacing dozens. The United Nations reported 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israelske styrker fortsetter koalisjonsforhandlinger, med samtaler som får momentum og en kandidat som er navngitt for å danne neste regjering, mens israelske bosettere tok åtte palestinske hjem i Jeriko, og forflyttet dusinvis. approved.en: Israel is positioning forces to resume an offensive in southern Lebanon, contingent on renewed fighting with Iran, while Hezbollah continues artillery fire on Israeli positions and has begun cash payments to war victims and displaced families. The Israeli army has built a new road in the Shebaa Valley buffer zone, expanding its presence near the border. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon by the fighting. 4,335 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den israelske hæren har bygget en ny vei i bufferområdet Shebaa-dalen, og utvider sin tilstedeværelse nær grensen. FN rapporterer at 300 000 personer er fordrevet i Libanon på grunn av kampene. 4 335 dødsfall knyttet til kamp forekom i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi forces continue a month-long siege of Taiz while Yemeni government troops have seized the strategic al-Jawf mountain range, intensifying front-line fighting. The Saudi-led coalition intercepted a Houthi cruise missile and a long-range anti-tank guided missile over Riyadh and downed a Houthi ballistic missile aimed at Medina. A Saudi strike near Sanaa killed 22 people, mostly women and children, and an airstrike near the capital killed 22 people, according to Houthi officials. The Yemeni president has sacked ministers and officers in an attempt to turn the tide of the war. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Houthi-styrkene fortsetter en månedslang beleiring av Taiz mens jemenittiske regjeringsstyrker har erobret den strategiske al-Jawf-fjellkjeden, noe som intensiverer frontlinjekampene. Den saudisk-ledede koalisjonen avskjærte et houthi-kryssmissil og et langdistanse-antitank-styrt missil over Riyadh og skjøt ned et houthi-ballistisk missil rettet mot Medina. Et saudisk angrep nær Sanaa drepte 22 personer, hovedsakelig kvinner og barn, og et luftangrep nær hovedstaden drepte 22 personer, ifølge houthi-offiserer. Den jemenittiske presidenten har sparket ministre og offiserer i et forsøk på å snu krigens gang. Konflikten forårsaket 918 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Syria is deploying troops and military advisers to Saudi Arabia to help counter Houthi attacks under a new defence cooperation deal that includes $403 million in loans. Syrian forces have also been involved in a landmine explosion in Deir ez-Zor that killed one soldier and wounded another, and they foiled a Hezbollah plot targeting the Homs refinery. The government seized more than 280 kg of narcotics smuggled from Lebanon and condemned a terrorist attack on security personnel in Amman. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Syriske styrker har også vært involvert i en landmineeksplosjon i Deir ez-Zor som drepte en soldat og såret en annen, og de avverget et Hezbollah-plan mot Homs-raffineriet. Regjeringen konfiskerte mer enn 280 kg narkotika smuglet fra Libanon og fordømte et terrorangrep på sikkerhetspersonell i Amman. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The conflict caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: City councils in Juba are now collecting over 600 tonnes of waste daily, mainly from Thongpiny, and will start road repairs and install speed bumps within a week. The government is preparing climate-justice submissions to the African Court and addressing food insecurity worsened by El Niño and prolonged dry spells. President Kiir has posthumously promoted General Joseph Lagu to full General, while the caretaker finance minister has pledged financial reforms as the UK reaffirms support. Machar said he took steps to prevent violence in Nasir and Ulang after fishing-net disputes sparked clashes, and a Kenyan preacher who urged followers to starve to death was sentenced to 200 years in prison. Two battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

President Kiir har posthumt forfremmet general Joseph Lagu til full general, mens den midlertidige finansministeren har lovet økonomiske reformer mens Storbritannia bekrefter sin støtte. Machar sa han tok skritt for å hindre vold i Nasir og Ulang etter at tvister om fiskegarn utløste sammenstøt, og en kenyansk predikant som oppfordret sine tilhengere til å sulte til døden ble dømt til 200 år i fengsel. To dødsfall knyttet til kamp ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

In northern Ethiopia, an RPG strike near a school in Moyale killed 60 Ethiopian Orthodox believers and led Inspector General Douglas Kanja to deploy additional police officers and hold security talks after a Kenyan was killed. The conflict has forced over 50,000 Ethiopian refugees to register in Kenya. The war caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Nord-Etiopia drepte et RPG-angrep nær en skole i Moyale 60 etiopiske ortodokse troende, og førte til at inspektørgeneralen Douglas Kanja sendte flere politifolk og holdt sikkerhetsmøter etter at en kenyansk ble drept. Konflikten har tvunget mer enn 50 000 etiopiske flyktninger til å registrere seg i Kenya. Krigen forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Somalia's Supreme Court has declared President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud's term extension unlawful, creating political uncertainty while al-Shabaab continues attacks, including a suspected assault on a police station and camp in Garissa and a warning that Houthi support could boost its capabilities. Ugandan troops are withdrawing from Somalia, with peacekeepers repositioning near the capital as the withdrawal proceeds. The United States has vacated the Baledogle airfield after more than a decade of use, and Turkey is reported to be considering taking over the now-empty facility. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Ugandiske tropper trekker seg tilbake fra Somalia, med fredsbevarere som flytter seg nær hovedstaden mens tilbaketrekkingen pågår. USA har forlatt Baledogle-flyplassen etter mer enn et tiår med bruk, og Tyrkia skal etter opplysninger vurdere å overta den nå tomme anlegget. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: M23 forces have seized positions in Rugezi after a week of fighting with Congolese government troops, while Joseph Kabila now leads a rebel coalition that includes M23. Rubio says the United States is in talks to establish a military presence in Venezuela and has floated a one-day operation to capture Maduro. The U.S. military is coordinating with Venezuela to launch drone strikes on cartels, and Trump defended the Hegseth amid an impeachment threat while citing successful operations in Iran and Venezuela. 2 battle-related deaths in 2007, according to UCDP.
